problem: Which of the following represents the level curves of $f(x,y)=\sqrt{3{x}^{2}+2{y}^{2}}?$
worked_solution:
The level curves for the function $f(x,y)$ are given by the equations 

$$
f(x,y)=c.
$$

Notice that the range of $f(x,y)$ is $[0,\infty ).$ So, we will consider only level curves for $c\ge 0.$

Therefore, we have:

$$
\begin{aligned}f(x,y) & =c \\ \sqrt{3{x}^{2}+2{y}^{2}} & =c \\ 3{x}^{2}+2{y}^{2} & ={c}^{2}\end{aligned}
$$

The equation above gives us a family of ellipses centered at the origin. Therefore, the correct graph is as follows:
